details.description: Prolyte ORS Liquid - Apple 200 ml Tetra Pak is a WHO-recommended ORS formulation manufactured by Cipla Health Ltd. It helps in quick recovery from dehydration and restores body fluids and electrolytes. The apple-flavoured liquid contains a healthy blend of ingredients that aid faster recovery from conditions like diarrhoea and vomiting, providing instant relief and energy. The apple flavour makes it easier to consume like a juice with medicinal value.
details.usageInstructions:
Ready to drink.
Insert straw and drink at once.

details.description: Prolyte ORS Nimbu Paani Tetra is a WHO-recommended oral rehydration solution that helps you quickly recover from dehydration and restore your body's fluids and electrolytes. Formulated with glucose and essential electrolytes, this refreshing lemon-flavoured drink provides an instant recharge to your body, replenishing what's lost due to conditions like vomiting and diarrhoea. Its appetising taste makes it easy to drink, even when experiencing indigestion symptoms. Quench your thirst, beat the summer heat, and stay energised and hydrated throughout the day with this convenient and effective rehydration solution.

ORS Prolyte Orange Liquid manufactured by Cipla Health Ltd. is a WHO-recommended ORS formulation which helps in quick recovery from dehydration and restores body fluids and electrolytes. Rehydration is essential in conditions like diarrhoea and vomiting where there is a loss of body fluids. The ORS Prolyte Orange liquid offers an instant and tasty solution to dehydration. The ingredients have been blended in such a way that it serves your taste buds and balances electrolytes. The orange flavour calms the digestive system while replenishing the fluids needed by the body. It is easy to consume and also highly effective. Explore the wide range of ORS Prolyte liquids available in various flavours such as apple, orange, and lemon (nimbu paani) on Big Basket.

Prolyte ORS Mixed Fruit Electrolyte is a refreshing low-calorie drink designed for instant hydration. This unique blend effectively restores electrolytes lost during physical activity, ensuring optimal body functioning. It's packed with key ingredients such as sodium chloride, potassium chloride, sodium citrate, and dextrose, which are vital for maintaining hydration and energy levels. With a delightful mixed fruit flavour, Prolyte ORS not only replenishes your body but also tantalises your taste buds, making it a perfect companion for fitness enthusiasts and those leading an active lifestyle.
details.usageInstructions:
1. The dose should be appropriately adjusted to patient's requirement for maintenance and replacement of fluids.
2. Do not buy/consume if the pack is puffed.
3. Use the content within 24 hours after opening.

details.description: Prolyte Aam Panna Flavour ORS is a refreshing, low-calorie drink formulated to provide instant hydration and restore essential electrolytes. Based on the WHO-recommended ORS formula, it is suitable for use during illness, recovery, or whenever the body needs quick rehydration. With its tangy Aam Panna taste, it offers both effective hydration and delightful flavour.

Prolyte Jeera Flavour ORS is a convenient, easy-to-mix solution designed to quickly replenish lost fluids and electrolytes during dehydration caused by diarrhoea, vomiting, or excessive sweating. With the added comfort of a mild jeera (cumin) flavour, it encourages hydration, making it suitable for adults and children alike. This ORS supports electrolyte balance, promotes rapid recovery, and ensures your body stays hydrated and energized whenever needed.
details.ingredients: (Per 200 Ml): Sodium Chloride IP 0.52 G, Potassium Chloride IP 0.30 G, Sodium Citrate IP 0.58 G, Dextrose Anhydrous IP 2.70 G, Excipients Q.S.
details.storageInstructions:
Store at a temperature not exceeding 30°C.
Dose: The dose should be appropriately adjusted to the patient's requirement for maintenance and replacement of fluids.
DO NOT BUY/CONSUME IF THE PACK IS PUFFED.
Use the content within 24 hours after opening.
Indications: To be used in conditions of diarrhoea, vomiting, and when there is loss of water and electrolytes. ORS can be a good replacement of lost fluids and electrolytes.
Caution: Depressed renal function. Severe continuing diarrhoea or other critical fluid losses may need supplementation with other parenteral fluids along with ORS.

details.description: Prolyte ElectroShot Mango Mania is a delicious fruit juice-based electrolyte drink designed to keep you rehydrated. Packed with vital electrolytes, it helps replenish essential minerals lost during physical activity or heat. Enjoy its refreshing mango flavour while maintaining hydration and energy throughout your day.

Prolyte Nimbu Paani Flavour ORS is a refreshing low-calorie drink formulated for quick dehydration recovery. Made with the WHO-recommended ORS formula, it helps replenish electrolytes and restore fluids effectively. Suitable during illness, recovery, or daily hydration needs, its classic lemon flavour offers both effective rehydration and a naturally refreshing taste.
details.ingredients: Sodium Chloride IP 2.6 G, Potassium Chloride IP 1.5 G, Sodium Citrate IP 2.9 G, Dextrose IP (Anhydrous) 13.5 G, Excipients Q.S.
details.storageInstructions:
Store in cool & dry place
Dosage: Depending upon age and severity of dehydration.
Infants and Children: 1-2 Litres (5-10 glasses) over a period of 24 hours.
Adult: 2-4 litres (10-20 glasses) over a period of 24 hours.
Caution
Use with caution in impaired renal function or intestinal obstruction.
Solution to be used within 24 hours.
Discard the unused solution.
